headline: Public hearing on a second-floor ADU unit at 66 Concord Street and a shed at 85 Concord Street.
summary: The agenda includes a request to add an ADU unit to a replica of the demolished Carriage House at 66 Concord Street. It also includes a proposed 8' by 12' shed at 85 Concord Street, custom-built to look like the house on site.
items: Old business: add an ADU unit on the second floor of a replica of the demolished Carriage House at 66 Concord Street (Crimson Properties, LLC)
New business: proposed 8' by 12' shed custom-built to look like the house at 85 Concord Street (Kristine & David Mitchell)
Communications: Historic Building Evaluation & Analysis exercise of individual buildings in the Nashville Historic District
location: Room 208, Nashua City Hall, 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH
plain_text:
C i t y  o f  N a s h u a  
Planning Department 
229 Main Street 
Nashua, New Hampshire 03061-2019 
 
November 2, 2026 
Notice is hereby given that a Public Hearing of the City of Nashua 
Historic District Commission will occur on Monday, November 23, 
2026, at 6:00 P.M., in Room 208 at Nashua City Hall, located at 229 
Main Street, Nashua, NH.  Members of the public can submit their 
comments via email zb@nashuanh.gov or by mail (please make sure to 
include your name/address and comments) by 4:00 p.m. on November 
20, 2026, and read into the record at the appropriate time. Letters 
should be addressed to City of Nashua, Planning Department, P.O. 
Box 2019, Nashua, NH 03061. Plans can be viewed online starting 
November 17, 2026 at www.nashuanh.gov. 
 
Old Business: 
 
1. Crimson Properties, LLC (Owner), 66 Concord Street (Sheet 66 
Lot 193), requesting the following: Add an ADU unit on the 
second floor of a replica of the demolished Carriage House, 
created to architecturally match the 66 Concord Street home 
but reversing the previously approved layout. The location and 
materials used will remain the same as previously proposed.  The 
property is located in the HDC Overlay & RB Zone, Ward 3. 
 
New Business: 
 
2. Kristine & David Mitchell (Owner); 85 Concord Street (Sheet 
47 Lot 31) Proposed 8’ by 12' shed custom-built to look like 
the house on site; located in the HDC Overlay & RA Zone, Ward 
3. 
 
Other Business: 
 
1. Review of Minutes for previous hearings/meetings. 
2. Communications 
a) 2027 Meeting Calendar 
 
b) CLG Renewal 
 
c) Historic Building Evaluation & Analysis exercise of 
individual buildings located in the Nashville Historic 
District
